- [major] REQ-008 invents behavior (polar conversion of a real scalar raising an LCD error) that contradicts the physical TI-36X Pro, where real↔polar conversion of a real number is a valid operation, violating the intent's equivalence-to-the-physical-device invariant shared with REQ-004. (REQ-008) Fix: Remove the real-scalar error example and state only that conversions inapplicable to the current result (e.g., polar conversion of a non-real result in an unsupported mode) surface an error without destroying it.
- [minor] REQ-009 introduces 'confirmed clear-variable operation' (an explicit confirmation step) that neither INT-001 nor INT-002 requests, adding unauthorized interaction design beyond filling the implemented-vs-intended gap. (REQ-009) Fix: Restate the clear-variable requirement as clearing stored variables to the chosen label without prescribing a confirmation mechanism.
